text:
Maya Nguyen: Heads up — webinar promo going live next Tue. Need final assets + posting schedule for X and LinkedIn. Who can pick up copy and scheduling?
Alex Park: I can draft the X thread + LI 1-liner. Need slides + hero image assets.
Liam O'Connor: I'll export final slides by EOD today. cc @Chris Patel for hero image variants :+1:
Chris Patel: On it. Sending hero variants by 4pm. Which aspect ratios do we need? 16:9 for LI, 1:1 for X card?
Maya Nguyen: Yes to both. Also want to call out a benchmark stat in the thread — thinking "2x latency improvement". Need legal sign-off for metrics though.
Alex Park: prefer "2x latency improvement" then. "2x cost savings" might require backup. @LegalBot — can you confirm?
LegalBot: "2x latency improvement" is cleared for public messaging. Any cost/savings claims need documented backup before publishing.
Maya Nguyen: Great. Schedule target: Tue 10:00 PT for X thread, 11:00 PT for LinkedIn post. @Liam can you upload to Buffer and include UTM params?
Liam O'Connor: Yes — will schedule in Buffer. Posting times:
- X thread: 2026-04-28 10:00 PT
- LinkedIn: 2026-04-28 11:00 PT
UTM: utm_source=x_social&utm_campaign=webinar_launch
Alex Park: I'll drop draft copy in #marketing-docs for quick review. Plan to include two engagement follow-ups in the X thread: 1) sign-up CTA with link, 2) 30s highlight clip as a follow-up reply.
Maya Nguyen: Assigning inbound routing to SDRs: @Jules Martin and @Priya Singh — can you own lead routing and slack alerts?
Jules Martin: On it. We'll route >50 MQLs to AE queue, others to nurture list. Will add tags for demo requests.
Priya Singh: Can we get a webhook into #inbound-leads to ping the SDRs on new signups? Also want a 1-hour rolling alert for hot signups.
Maya Nguyen: Yes — @Sam Reed from eng-infra to set up webhook. Alex will flag infra if needed.
Sam Reed: I'll set up the webhook and confirm by EOD. Will include payload with email, company, utm_campaign.
Alex Park: I'll ping Sam directly if I need any extra fields in the payload.
Maya Nguyen: Awesome — quick recap of action items: slides export (Liam), hero images (Chris), copy draft (Alex), Buffer schedule (Liam), legal cleared (LegalBot), webhook (Sam), SDR routing (Jules/Priya). Thanks :rocket:
